description: The file defines the code-behind class for an ASP.NET Web Forms page named Dashboard. It includes event handlers for various button clicks that navigate to different pages within the online examination system.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: A partial class representing the server-side logic for the Dashboard page of the online examination system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for the page load event, currently with no implemented logic.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the home button click, currently with no implemented logic.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the profile button click; transfers user to the UserProfile.aspx page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the leaderboard button click; transfers user to the Leaderboard.aspx page.

methods.name: sExamB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the start exam button click; transfers user to the StartExam.aspx page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the logout button click; transfers user to the LoginPage.aspx.
